note: Lab news, shown as headlines on news.html (all items, grouped by year) and on the Home page (the 5 newest from the past 12 months). Add an item at the top: date as YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM when the day isn't known; type is one of talk, grant, award, paper, media, people, event, other (shown as Announcement); headline is one line; link is optional (a LinkedIn post, article, or page on this site); source is optional and replaces the label taken from the link. Don't copy publication entries here: a 'paper' item is a one-line 'accepted at' headline.
